name: application-tip-selector
title: Tip Selector
description: Preset tip-percentage buttons with a computed tip amount, total, and per-person split — distinct from tiered-donation-buttons, which select a flat impact-labeled donation amount rather than a percentage of a bill with a split calculation.
useWhen: Letting a user pick a tip percentage against a known bill amount.
You want the tip, total, and per-person split all computed live from the same bill and percentage.
A group needs to split the total evenly across multiple people.
avoidWhen: You're collecting a flat charitable donation amount with impact labels — use tiered-donation-buttons instead.
The bill amount is unknown or variable — collect it first before showing this component.
Splitting isn't needed — omit the per-person row rather than showing a redundant single-person split.
responsiveBehavior: Preset buttons share equal width via flex-1 and remain in a single row down to narrow container widths.
accessibility: Preset buttons use role='group' with an aria-label and aria-pressed to convey the selected percentage to assistive tech.
The selected percentage is also shown as text in the tip line, not conveyed only by button highlight color.
The per-person split row is omitted entirely when splitCount is 1, rather than showing a redundant identical total.

variants.title: Tip selector
variants.description: An $84.50 bill with 20% tip selected, computing a $16.90 tip, $101.40 total, and $33.80 per-person split across 3 people, on a light surface.
accessibility: Tip, total, and per-person amounts are all derived from the same real billAmount and selectedPercent, never hand-typed independently.

variants.title: Tip selector (Dark)
variants.description: The same tip selector, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected/unselected button states meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
